close_reason: Confirmed correct per RFC 5280 §4.2.1.10 mask-and-compare algorithm
description: matches_ip_address (line 1058) implements RFC 5280's IP constraint check as (subject & mask == addr & mask) for each byte. This is exactly the RFC algorithm and handles both IPv4 (4/8 bytes) and IPv6 (16/32 bytes) in one pass. It's correct and not overcomplicated. Defend against suggestions to use a CIDR library or parse prefix length separately — the RFC encodes the constraint as addr+mask bytes precisely to avoid that.
title: matches_ip_address uses mask-and-compare, not CIDR calculation
